decisions.briefing: Markets sold off broadly today with NASDAQ down 2.0% and the S&P 500 down 1.4%, firmly risk-off conditions. No new candidates were screened, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash in reserve rather than forcing a buy into weakness.

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 today, with tech-heavy NASDAQ underperforming the broader S&P 500, a pattern typical of risk-off days when investors rotate out of higher-beta growth names first. Without specific confirmed headlines available today, the decline appears consistent with general risk aversion rather than any single catalyst. On days like this, preserving capital and avoiding forced trades matters more than chasing a rebound.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍下跌，科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅達2.0%，跑輸標普500指數的1.4%跌幅，這是典型的「風險規避」(risk-off)市況下常見的現象，投資者傾向先拋售波動較大的成長股。由於今日沒有明確的新聞標題可供引用，這次下跌看起來較符合整體市場避險情緒，而非單一事件觸發。在這類日子，保住本金比追逐反彈更為重要。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safer holdings or cash, often causing most stocks and indices to fall together. The smart response isn't to panic-sell your existing holdings or panic-buy to 'catch a dip' — it's to let your stop-loss and profit-target rules work automatically and simply wait for clearer signals before adding new positions.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off) 是指投資者普遍拋售成長股等風險較高的資產，轉向較安全的資產或現金，導致大部分股票和指數同時下跌。聰明的應對方式不是恐慌性拋售現有持股，也不是急於「撈底」買入，而是讓停損和獲利出場的規則自動發揮作用，並耐心等待更明確的訊號才加碼新倉位。
